description.value:
You sculpt a barrier of trash that blocks sight and once broken, impedes foes. You create a 1-foot-thick wall of junk in either a hemisphere with a radius of 10 feet or a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high. The wall doesn't have to be vertical, but it must be anchored on both sides to a solid surface and can't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 5, 20 Hit Points, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section leaves behind a heap of jagged scrap that's difficult and hazardous terrain, dealing 2d6 slashing damage to a creature that enters the terrain for the first time on its turn.

Heightened (+2) The slashing damage increases by 1d6.
